excerpt: Registering is easy with Unemployment Tax Registration (UTR), TWC's quick and free online service.
If you cannot finish your registration, you can easily access it on UTR for up to one year. This way, you can come back later and continue where you left off.
If you are liable, you will immediately receive a TWC tax account number.
UTR will allow you to immediately file any reports or pay taxes that are due. But you must do it as part of the registration process.
You can use the same user ID and password to access UTR and UTS.
Learn about UTS to file wage reports, pay taxes, or manage an existing tax account online.
Install QuickFile for free to report over 1000 employees directly from a formatted file on your computer.
